milestones.name: Save Zote in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight can choose to save or leave Zote trapped in Vengefly King's mandibles in Greenpath

milestones.name: Zote dies in Greenpath
milestones.note: If not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw, Zote dies; hitting his shell grants the Neglect achievement

milestones.name: Neglect achievement
milestones.note: Granted by hitting Zote's shell after he dies in Greenpath

milestones.name: Zote appears in Dirtmouth
milestones.note: If saved in Greenpath, Zote appears in Dirtmouth

milestones.name: Zote found in City of Tears
milestones.note: Zote found in a corridor leading back to the storerooms of the City of Tears; has forgotten the Knight

milestones.name: Save Zote in Deepnest
milestones.note: Zote found stuck in spider webs in Deepnest; Knight can save or leave him

milestones.name: Zote captured at Colosseum of Fools
milestones.note: If saved both times, Zote is found in the resting area of the Colosseum of Fools

milestones.name: Defeat Zote at Colosseum of Fools
milestones.note: Zote becomes the final boss of the first trial; defeating him grants the Rivalry achievement

milestones.name: Rivalry achievement
milestones.note: Granted by beating Zote at the Colosseum of Fools

milestones.name: Mantis Claw acquired
milestones.note: Referenced as a progression gate for Zote's survival in Greenpath

milestones.name: Enter Fungal Wastes
milestones.note: Humid area near the middle of Hallownest; contains sub-areas Queen's Station, Mantis Village, and Fungal Core

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.fingerprintHint: Humid fungal grove, home to creatures not quite bug and not quite plant; middle of Hallownest
zones.note: Contains sub-areas: Queen's Station, Mantis Village, Fungal Core

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Leafy caverns above Fungal Wastes; location where Zote is first found
zones.note: Zote found trapped by Vengefly King here

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Town above Hallownest; Zote relocates here after being saved
zones.note: Zote appears here after being saved in Greenpath

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected to Fungal Wastes; Zote found in corridor to storerooms
zones.note: Zote found in a corridor leading to storerooms

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected to Fungal Wastes; Zote found stuck in spider webs
zones.note: Zote found trapped in spider webs here

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where Zote is the final boss of the first trial
zones.note: Zote found in resting area; becomes final boss of first trial

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Referenced as a progression gate; if Zote is not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw, he dies in Greenpath

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles; Knight can choose to fight it to save Zote

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of the first trial; deals no damage due to shellwood nail; defeating grants Rivalry achievement
